description: This file declares the MaximumPlayerConfigurationExplorer class and related functions for exploring maximum feasible player configurations on a platform, including support for creating and destroying player instances, and testing configuration support.

classes.name: MaximumPlayerConfigurationExplorer
classes.description: Class to explore and determine maximum feasible configurations of players that can run concurrently.

methods.name: CalculateMaxTestConfigs
methods.description: Calculates and returns the maximum test configurations for players.

methods.name: IsConfigCreatable
methods.description: Checks if a given configuration of players can be supported by the system.

methods.name: CreatePlayerInstance
methods.description: Creates a player instance based on a given configuration.
